tested_question: What are the HV substation equipment?
direct_answer_preview: High-voltage substations combine primary equipment, protection, control and auxiliary systems to transform, switch, measure and protect electric power. Key items include Power Transformers, Circuit Breakers, Disconnect Switches, Gas-Insulated Switchgear, Instrument Transformers, Surge Arresters, Busbars, Protection & Control Systems, Station Service Systems.
